verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line listing a 'Gemini AI assistant in Gmail' and a Meet 'Take notes for me' AI feature. Together they suggest some natural-language AI assistance, but nothing shows users can operate the product (issue commands, perform actions, administer settings) through natural language. Missing for 10: documentation of natural-language command capabilities and their scope, coverage beyond Gmail (Docs, Drive, Admin console), evidence of actions executed from natural-language prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
